runs.theme: cobalt (catalog, trimmed: no command palette, no live-code hero, no graphite band, no Google Fonts CDN)
runs.macrostructure: app pages -- existing sidebar+topbar+content shell kept as-is, visual skin only
runs.notes: v3 of this app's visual system. v1 (system font, zero cards) and v2 (Inter/indigo, elevated cards+shadows, 20px radii) both shipped and were superseded. v3: OKLCH tokens, self-hosted Space Grotesk/Inter/JetBrains Mono, tight 6px/10px radii, depth from border only (no box-shadow), mono face reserved for tabular numbers + uppercase eyebrow labels. design.md at project root is the system of record.
